disclaimer: Demo fact sheets summarised for the hackathon. Amounts and limits are approximate. Always verify on the official portal before applying.

schemes.name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Scholarship
schemes.summary: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for post-matric students from eligible categories studying in Telangana.
schemes.benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement plus a monthly maintenance allowance, paid through the ePASS system.
schemes.eligibility_text: Student, resident of Telangana, belongs to SC, ST, BC, EBC or similar eligible category, and family annual income within the state limit (about Rs 2 lakh, Rs 2.5 lakh for SC/ST).

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
schemes.summary: Central scholarship that supports Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matric courses.
schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance and non-refundable compulsory fees for the course duration.
schemes.eligibility_text: Student belonging to a Scheduled Caste with parental income up to about Rs 2.5 lakh per year.

schemes.name: Central Sector Scholarship for College Students
schemes.summary: Merit-based scholarship for college and university students from families with limited income.
schemes.benefits: Annual scholarship amount for undergraduate and postgraduate studies.
schemes.eligibility_text: Student in a regular degree course, merit based on class 12 results, family income up to about Rs 4.5 lakh per year.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.summary: Direct income support to landholding farmer families.
schemes.benefits: Rs 6,000 per year paid in three instalments directly to the bank account.
schemes.eligibility_text: Farmer family owning cultivable land. Certain high-income categories and institutional landholders are excluded.

schemes.name: Telangana Rythu Bharosa (Farmer Investment Support)
schemes.summary: Per-acre investment support for farmers in Telangana each crop season.
schemes.benefits: Per-acre financial support paid each season to eligible farmers.
schemes.eligibility_text: Farmer cultivating land in Telangana. Check current state guidelines for land-size and crop conditions.

schemes.name: Aarogyasri Health Coverage (Telangana)
schemes.summary: Cashless health coverage for treatment in network hospitals for eligible families.
schemes.benefits: Cashless treatment up to the state-defined annual cover at empanelled hospitals.
schemes.eligibility_text: Resident of Telangana with a white ration card or family income below the state limit (about Rs 5 lakh per year).

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
schemes.summary: Free LPG connection for women from poor households.
schemes.benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection with support for the first refill and stove.
schemes.eligibility_text: Adult woman from a below-poverty-line household without an existing LPG connection.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.summary: Small-savings scheme with a higher interest rate for the future of a girl child.
schemes.benefits: Tax-advantaged savings account for a girl child, opened by a parent or guardian.
schemes.eligibility_text: Account can be opened for a girl child up to 10 years of age.

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Loan
schemes.summary: Collateral-free loans for small businesses and self-employed people.
schemes.benefits: Loans in the Shishu, Kishore and Tarun categories for small business needs.
schemes.eligibility_text: Adult running or starting a small non-farm business such as a shop, service or small manufacturing unit.
documents: Business plan or proof of business

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople with skill training, toolkit and credit.
schemes.benefits: Recognition, skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive and low-interest credit.
schemes.eligibility_text: Adult artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the listed traditional trades.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan)
schemes.summary: Working-capital loans for street vendors with incentives for digital payments.
schemes.benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan with interest subsidy on timely repayment.
schemes.eligibility_text: Street vendor with a certificate of vending or a letter of recommendation from the local body.
documents: Certificate of vending or recommendation letter
